# Advanced Telegram Economy

> Advanced Telegram Economy is a self-hosted Telegram economy bot for Node.js, built with Telegraf, TypeORM and SQLite. It adds salaries, a central bank, a market, cases, slots, money transfers and rankings to Telegram chats, in English or Turkish.

Run it from a clone with `npm install`, then `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN=... LANG=en npm run start`. Set `LANG=tr` (or a Turkish locale such as `tr_TR.UTF-8`) for Turkish; any other language gives English. Data is stored in `data.sqlite` in the working directory.

## Docs

- [Home](https://projects.halit.org/advanced-telegram-economy/): overview of the bot's main features
- [Installation](https://projects.halit.org/advanced-telegram-economy/installation.html): cloning the repository, installing dependencies and running the bot in dev or production mode
- [Telegram gaming bot](https://projects.halit.org/advanced-telegram-economy/telegram-gaming-bot/): what the economy game gives a group, every command in English and Turkish, three-step setup
- [Blog](https://projects.halit.org/advanced-telegram-economy/blog/): Telegram bot guides for Node.js developers

## Blog

- [Make a Telegram bot in Node.js with Telegraf, step by step](https://projects.halit.org/advanced-telegram-economy/blog/how-to-make-a-telegram-bot.html): Make a Telegram bot with Node.js and Telegraf: get a token from BotFather, answer commands, store data in SQLite, then run it in a group. Real code included.
- [Get a Telegram bot token from BotFather and keep it safe](https://projects.halit.org/advanced-telegram-economy/blog/telegram-bot-token.html): Get a Telegram bot token from BotFather with /newbot, test it with getMe, keep it out of git with an env variable, and replace it with /token if it leaks.
- [Why a Telegram bot does not respond, and how to fix it](https://projects.halit.org/advanced-telegram-economy/blog/telegram-bot-not-responding.html): Telegram bot not responding? Check the token, a second running copy, the webhook, privacy mode in groups, admin rights and the command language. With fixes.
- [Telegram Bot API sendMessage, explained with Node.js examples](https://projects.halit.org/advanced-telegram-economy/blog/telegram-bot-api-sendmessage.html): The Telegram Bot API sendMessage method in Node.js: ctx.reply vs telegram.sendMessage, parse modes, MarkdownV2 escaping, replies, topics and editing messages.
- [Telegram bots: webhook or long polling?](https://projects.halit.org/advanced-telegram-economy/blog/telegram-bot-webhook-vs-polling.html): Webhook vs long polling for Telegram bots in Node.js: how getUpdates and setWebhook work, ports and secret tokens, and why a SQLite bot is fine with polling.
- [How a Telegram game bot runs an economy inside a group](https://projects.halit.org/advanced-telegram-economy/blog/telegram-game-bot.html): How a Telegram game bot can run an economy game in a group chat: salaries with a captcha, a central bank, a market, crates and rankings, explained from code.
- [What a Telegram bot is and how it works](https://projects.halit.org/advanced-telegram-economy/blog/what-is-a-telegram-bot.html): What is a Telegram bot? A program that uses the Bot API to answer messages, run commands and manage groups. How bots work, what they can do and their limits.
- [Serverless Telegram bots: what works and what does not](https://projects.halit.org/advanced-telegram-economy/blog/serverless-telegram-bot.html): Can a Telegram bot run serverless? Yes, with a webhook and external storage. Why a bot that keeps SQLite and in-memory state needs a small always-on server.
